atoms.MEAN(x,m): representation x reaches or expresses meaning configuration m
atoms.ISO(x,y,m): x and y are meaning-equivalent with respect to m
atoms.PATH(x,m,o,p): observer o reaches m from x through cognitive path p
atoms.DIFF(p,q): paths p and q are experientially different
atoms.BOUND(m,b): accessible meaning m is constrained by boundary b
atoms.PROBE(x,m): x is used to probe meaning space m
atoms.MULTIEXP(m): meaning m admits multiple surface expressions
atoms.NEWTOPO(m): m denotes a newly reached meaning topology relative to the current basis
atoms.NOTSURFACE(x): surface replacement x alone is not counted as topological novelty
